content_of_post_to_comment: If Christianity were true, it would be totally irrelevant. That’s because according to Christianity only your soul goes to heaven. But why should I care about my soul? I’m a person made of flesh and blood, why would I care if my soul went to heaven? Why should I care if it went to hell for that matter? I’d much rather enjoy the freedom here on earth if the only price for this is to send some kind of immaterial soul to hell
